name: PING
author: Cannon Tuttle
description: A twist on Pong: move, lunge and catch the ball; choose colors, difficulty and match length. Up to 4 players with several gamepads. Arrows to move, X/Z to lunge or catch.

descriptions.en: A twist on Pong: move, lunge and catch the ball; choose colors, difficulty and match length. Up to 4 players with several gamepads. Arrows to move, X/Z to lunge or catch.
descriptions.it: Una variante di Pong: muoviti, allungati e afferra la palla; scegli colori, difficoltà e durata. Fino a 4 giocatori con più joypad. Frecce per muoverti, X/Z per allungarti o afferrare.
